module.name: local-mutation
module.description: Distinguish fresh local computation from externally observable mutation.

scenarios.name: should allow local computation
scenarios.given: variables declared in the current function or its blocks
scenarios.when: an assignment or increment is inspected
scenarios.then: the write is recognized as local

scenarios.name: should allow fresh local construction
scenarios.given: a fresh local array or object with no earlier escape
scenarios.when: a direct property write or mutating method is inspected
scenarios.then: the mutation is recognized as local

scenarios.name: should retain shared-state diagnostics
scenarios.given: an argument, outer binding, this, nested property, or alias of shared data
scenarios.then: the mutation is not classified as safely local

scenarios.name: should reject escaped containers
scenarios.given: a fresh container passed or aliased before mutation or captured by a closure
scenarios.then: the container is conservatively treated as shared

scenarios.name: should account for publication on previous loop iterations
scenarios.given: a persistent local container published later within a loop body
scenarios.when: a mutation before that publication is checked
scenarios.then: the mutation is treated as observable; containers recreated inside the body remain eligible for local mutation

scenarios.name: should preserve local ownership through initializer assertions
scenarios.given: a fresh container initializer wrapped in as, satisfies, angle-bracket, or non-null assertions
scenarios.then: fresh local construction is allowed while shared aliases, accessor writes, and earlier publication remain checked

scenarios.name: should retain accessor write diagnostics
scenarios.given: a fresh object with a matching named, quoted, or computed accessor
scenarios.when: an assignment or update targets that accessor or an unknown key
scenarios.then: the mutation is not classified as safely local

scenarios.name: should allow independent data writes and deletion
scenarios.given: a fresh object containing an accessor
scenarios.when: an unrelated data property is written or the accessor is deleted
scenarios.then: the operation remains local because it does not invoke the accessor

scenarios.name: should retain object method diagnostics
scenarios.given: a fresh object referring to an arbitrary mutator method
scenarios.then: local allocation alone does not exempt the call
